Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear ask.

Attached is our latest SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2025-12-31). The audit coverage window documented in that report is 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

Because your renewal date (2027-01-15) falls outside that window, we can provide a temporary coverage (bridge) letter that attests to continuous controls and any significant changes since the last report. The typical bridge we issue covers up to 12 months beyond the report date; in practice we tailor language to procurement/vendor requirements.

Next steps I recommend: 
- We can share a draft bridge letter for legal review (attached stub).
- If Greenlight needs signed/attested coverage for a specific procurement window, please confirm the exact date range you need covered and any required language.
- Marissa (sales/legal) and Neha (security) are cc'd to assist with contract language and evidence binder links.

Hi Samantha — quick technical note on coverage and what the bridge will include.

Confirmed: the attached Type II report covers controls operating from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31. Our bridge letter typically:
- Affirms no material changes to control environment since the last report date,
- Lists any control changes and compensating controls (if applicable),
- Provides the signed statement from our Head of Security and VP of Engineering.

If you need a bridge to specifically cover 2026-01-01 through 2027-01-15 we can draft that, but procurement often wants a bridge that overlaps the renewal month. Please confirm whether Greenlight requires coverage to start from 2026-01-01 or some other date.

Also — here's a link to our evidence binder that contains SOC scope, control narratives, and sample artifacts: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcD-ExampleSOC2Binder.

For timing: we can provide a signed bridge within 3 business days of finalizing language. If Greenlight needs a countersigned DocuSign, we can route it — sample link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC-Redwood-Bridge
